title: fix(mcp): the record resource answers a code-less throw as /api/v1/data does, so a sandboxed hook abort no longer names the hook
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X3apZSKwFDd6zvjM4gJPKAy)_

Fixes #31270

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的记录资源(`objectstack://objects/{name}/records/{id}`)遇到不带错误码的异常时,改为与六个记录数据工具相同的读法(`/api/v1/data` 的 `mapDataError`):沙箱 hook 业务中止回 `HOOK_ABORTED` + 作者那句话 + 400;裸 `Error` 和沙箱崩溃(带不带码都一样)回 `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` `Internal server error`,原文只记服务端日志。
- 为什么改:之前资源对无码异常原样回 `{ error: 抛出的消息 }`,沙箱中止时就是 `hook 'NAME' threw: …`,把 hook 内部名交给客户端;故障原文也直接外泄。
- 风险与回滚:资源 JSON 的成员仍是 #23509 的 `{ error, code, status }`,只是无码异常现在也会带 `code`(门给出时)和 `status`;读资源的客户端会在无码异常上也看到这两个成员。只改 `@objectstack/mcp`,patch。回滚即还原 `bridgeResources` 的 catch。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` 的 `bridgeResources` catch;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` 记录资源 describe 里的 #31270 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31270`,预期 5 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The record resource's catch (`MCPServerRuntime.bridgeResources`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`) answered a throw with no `code` as `{ error: THROWN_MESSAGE }`. It now reads the throw the way the six record data tools have since #31218. That read is `dataDoorAnswerOf` in `mcp-http-tools.ts`, which asks the `/data` door's own `mapDataError`. Its one change is the `export` keyword (seat amendment). It is not on `packages/mcp/src/index.ts`, so nothing published moves, and there is no copy of the classification. A 5xx is logged once through `logServerFault` (`[5xx] 500 resources/read objectstack://objects/OBJ/records/ID — …`), the same line the data tools print with their own coordinates.

The body keeps the #23509 members `{ error, code, status }`; only their values change on a code-less throw, and `code` and `status` can now appear there:

| Throw (code-less unless stated) | Before | Now | `GET /api/v1/data/OBJ/ID` (`mapDataError`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| sandboxed hook abort (`SandboxError`, `innerMessage`) | `{ error: "hook 'demo_guard' threw: Error: Not enough leave" }` | `{ error: 'Not enough leave', code: 'HOOK_ABORTED', status: 400 }` | `400 HOOK_ABORTED` `Not enough leave` |
| bare `Error('socket hang up')` | `{ error: 'socket hang up' }` | `{ error: 'Internal server error', code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', status: 500 }`, logged once | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` `Internal server error` |
| sandboxed CRASH, no code | `{ error: "hook 'demo_guard' threw: TypeError: boom" }` | `{ error: 'Internal server error', code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', status: 500 }`, logged once | same |
| sandboxed CRASH with a declared code (the #31269 shape) | `{ error: "hook 'demo_guard' threw: TypeError: boom" }` (since #31269, = the code-less crash) | the same sanitised 500: this closes #31269's deviation on this face | same |
| CONTROL: coded sandboxed refusal | `{ error: 'Locked.', code: 'RECORD_LOCKED', status: 409 }` | unchanged | `409 RECORD_LOCKED` `Locked.` |
| CONTROL: coded non-sandbox refusal | its own sentence, code, status | unchanged | n/a |
| `SQLITE_BUSY` (a coded driver string) | `{ error: 'SQLITE_BUSY: database is locked', code: 'SQLITE_BUSY' }` | unchanged: it rides the coded path | `500 DATABASE_ERROR` `Internal data error` |

The `SQLITE_BUSY` row was measured as the order asked. This code-less fix does not settle it: it is a coded driver string, #31273's subject, and is left for that card. Every tool's answer is unchanged (measured before and after on the same probe of 5 throws × 13 tools).

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`, the record-resource describe. The old row "a code-less throw answers `{ error }` byte-identically" is replaced by a `#31270` describe:
- undeclared sandboxed abort: `{ error: 'Not enough leave', code: 'HOOK_ABORTED', status: 400 }`, equal to `mapDataError`'s answer; no hook name, no `threw`;
- bare `Error`: the exact sanitised 500 text, equal to the door's; one `[5xx] 500 resources/read objectstack://objects/task/records/t1 — ` log line carrying the thrown text;
- sandboxed crash without and with a declared code: the exact sanitised 500; no hook name, no `TypeError`;
- a thrown string and an empty `code`: the door's answer;
- CONTROL: a coded sandboxed refusal keeps `Locked.` / `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409, a coded non-sandbox refusal keeps its own sentence byte for byte, and neither is logged.

<details><summary>Red first and ablation</summary>

Red first on `7c523aa1` (`main`, with PR #31290), new pins and no fix: `Tests 4 failed | 93 passed (97)`. The abort, bare `Error`, crash and string/empty-code rows failed; the CONTROL passed. With the fix: `Tests 97 passed (97)`.

Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `mcp-server-runtime.ts`): the code-less body `body = { error: door.message, ...(door.code !== undefined ? { code: door.code } : {}), status: door.status };` was replaced by one that answers the thrown message again. Output: `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob d53fa45008d0 -> 412ab95bb3d0`, then `Tests 4 failed | 93 passed (97)`, then `ok restored: blob == HEAD (d53fa45008d0) and git diff HEAD is empty`. The tests import the package's source, so no `dist/` is involved.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: no`. The resource's members are the ones #23509 set, and the values change on a code-less throw: `code` and `status` now appear there. The changeset says so for resource readers. `dataDoorAnswerOf` is exported from its module only; `index.ts` re-exports `mcp-http-tools.js` by name and does not list it.
- Not touched: the faces of #31271 (`run_action` / `resume_run`), #31272 (metadata tools, `list_actions`) and #31273 (driver string codes).
